The '''Greater Marianas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Greater Marianas]].
